objects.S_obs: observable causal condition; no supervision label for latent operator assignment
objects.gate: Z = Hy * G + Hx * (1-G); learned fusion weights, not financial factor weights
objects.K_i: learned latent transition matrix; training may use soft mixture, formal forecast uses argmax index to select the matrix
objects.N_candidate: preregistered instantiated matrix capacity before outcomes
objects.N_used: post-training occupancy under a declared support and assignment rule
objects.N_selected: research selection across registered capacities on common support; no selection in current stage
objects.epsilon_return: same-interval realized simple stock return minus previously frozen intercept and market/size/industry projection; only available after all returns mature
objects.residual_latent: Z_next - K_selected @ Z_current in the same frozen latent coordinate system
objects.account_other: account reconciliation remainder including costs, cash, holdings and omitted attribution effects; not pure alpha

evidence_requirements.causal_inputs: availability timestamp <= prediction timestamp; labels mature before fitting; transformations fit on training support only
evidence_requirements.financial_projection: frozen coefficients, identical return horizon/units/convention, observed factors; pure reference arithmetic does not verify external PIT metadata
evidence_requirements.stage4: unique role/clock/month, previous-month condition, finite input, exact frozen input hashes, no arbitrary deduplication
evidence_requirements.latent_comparison: freeze coordinate identity or compare output-space forecasts on exact common support; raw matrix distances alone are diagnostic
evidence_requirements.residual_mean: history-only conditional-mean errors and incremental predictive utility; no required amplitude match to realized residual
evidence_requirements.residual_distribution: history-only conditional distribution calibration and sampler terminal-prior compatibility; denoising fit/amplitude ratios alone insufficient
evidence_requirements.capacity: preregistered candidate family, comparator, objective, multiplicity and stop rule; lower-capacity failure does not mathematically close higher capacity
evidence_requirements.financial_acceptance: separate hard validity, evidence readiness and economic usefulness; an honest zero/negative or inconclusive result is permitted

historical_policy_scope: Earlier ontology, admission policies, annual workflow skill and current@1.0/@1.1/@1.2 remain historical records; their stage status and stronger residual/capacity claims are not current authority.
